What is AntiHunter?

 Hunt the hunters: AntiHunter is a compact digital and physical tripwire. It provides detection, defense and awareness for the devices around you. 

Leave one in a home, a vehicle, along a fence line, or around an event with no signal. It watches every wireless device and the activity around it, flags what doesn’t belong. Schedule scans, control other nodes and receive alerts over its long-range LoRa radio or onboard Wi-Fi (supports both Meshtastic & MeshCore).

 Defensive by design . No internet or subscription required, open source. Links up to TAK, MQTT and more with the additional Command Center software.

 What it does

- Scan your watchlist - Alerts the moment a MAC, vendor, or network name on your list shows up.
- Know who belongs - Learns a site, then flags new, returning, and moving devices.
- Catch Wi-Fi attacks - Spots death floods, fake access points, handshake capture & more.
- Track drones - Reads each drone's ID, position, altitude, and speed, and its pilot's position.
- Unmask rotating MACs - Links a phone's changing addresses back to one device.
- Guard the node - Feels anyone moving it and can respond. It senses people moving, even through walls.
- Run a fleet - Control nodes from one another, plan what each node scans and when, reach nodes out of range through the nodes between, and triangulate devices with 3+ nodes.
